selection.attacker_rule: Alternate five edge attackers (total degree exactly one) and five high-degree attackers (top one percent of eligible ASes by total degree). Exclude all selected holders/delegates, sample without replacement from ASN-sorted pools using random.Random(20260804), and require the DAROA-encoding public-origin eligibility gate.
selection.interpretation_warning: Selected pairs are empirical origin-divergence candidates; they are not asserted to be real delegations.
selection.pair_rule: Retain IPv4 candidate rows whose holder and delegate are public-AS eligible and present in the fixed graph. Collapse to unique holder-delegate pairs, choosing each pair's lowest source_row. Sort pairs by holder_degree+delegate_degree (then maximum endpoint degree, holder ASN, delegate ASN), and take the midpoint item from each of ten equal-rank bins. This stratifies topology degree; it does not infer or claim real delegation.
